info.name: AndPayments Platform
info.description:
GENERATED FILE - do not edit by hand.

Regenerate with `node postman/build-collection.mjs` whenever an edge HTTP route changes; `node postman/build-collection.mjs --check` fails if this file has drifted from the controllers. Push to the cloud copy with `node postman/sync.mjs --push --yes` (destructive: PUT replaces the whole collection).

Set the per-edge base URL variables below to whatever you are running. Set bearerToken from a POST /session/login response (auth edge for operators, vendor auth edge for vendor operators).
